prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a growing paper column; paper coins.
Opens on the folder stack, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips down as the folder stack rises into a tall paper column; coins pile at its base and hold.
Ends holding on the column.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "G&A $8.1M".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "G&A $8.1M". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "General costs rose three point four million, to eight point one.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

Below, in the center, is a cluster of black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of file folders, also with rough white torn edges, resting on a halftone paper scrap. The lighting comes consistently from the upper left, casting small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer. Every surface has a matte printed paper texture with visible print dots.

Starting on the first frame, a male narrator (S1), characterized by a warm, clear, natural, and brisk tone, speaks: <d>[English] General costs rose three point four million, to eight point one.</d> Simultaneously, the "4 ACQUISITIONS" chip flips downward and slides off-frame rapidly. In its place, a new cream-colored paper chip lands with a slight overshoot in the upper third, displaying the clean, stable, and legible black text "G&A $8.1M". In the lower two-thirds, the stack of folders rapidly transforms, sliding and stacking vertically to form a tall, structured paper column. As the column reaches its peak, several blank, unmarked black-and-white halftone paper coins slide in from the sides, piling up at the base of the column. By the end of the 5-second duration, the composition holds steady on the tall column and the coin pile under the "G&A $8.1M" headline, with a subtle, rhythmic shifting of the paper elements to create a small loop.
